title: Checkout steps on /checkout.html
caption: `src/pages/checkout.js` with `components/stepper.js`. Each step is a history entry (`step=travellers|contacts|extras|payment`); a step opens only when the steps before it are complete. The server-side checkout status is a separate lifecycle (see the OTA API's checkout states).

states.label: Price page
states.detail: Continue to checkout → `checkout.create` (sign-in first when guest checkout is off).

states.label: Travellers
states.detail: Fields from `requirements`; `setTravelers` with `ifMatch`. Stays here while `progress.missing` names its fields.

states.label: Contact details
states.detail: Pre-filled from the first adult and the account; `setContacts`.

states.label: Extras
states.detail: Only with `features.ancillaries`: bags, services, special requests (≤ 5).

states.label: Payment
states.detail: Methods of `config.payment.supportedMethods`, total, conditions, terms checkbox; `createPayment`.

states.label: Updated in another tab
states.detail: `412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`: reload, send the step once more on the new version; a second 412 offers Reload.

states.label: Your session expired
states.detail: `410 CHECKOUT_EXPIRED` → back to the price page to re-price.
